# Draft:Nimbalkar Dynasty

The Nimbalkar dynasty was an Indian Maratha royal house of Nimbalkar that has historically ruled over the parts of Maharashtra. They claim their ancestry from Agnivansha and to the Paramara dynasty. They served as Jagirdar to the Bahmani kingdom, Vijayanagara Empire, Maratha Empire and Nizam of Hyderabad.
Origins
The lineage of the Nimbalkar family goes back to an ancient personality named Nimbraj Pawar, who hailed from the northern part of India close to the city of Dhara. In the time of Muslim invasions and the formation of northern rule, Nimbraj moved southwards. Nimbraj followed rigorous spiritual practices in the forests close to the Kotual mountain for more than a decade, as per tradition. It is stated that a celestial vision bestowed upon him by a nearby goddess secured his and his line's position of future ruling and power.
